collection.description: A child has repeatedly taken another child's belongings without asking.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child has repeatedly taken another child's belongings without asking. Their parent, (name1), loves them dearly but knows the behavior must stop. The child protests that everyone is being unfair.

choices.label: Ask the Child to Help Make Amends

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child reluctantly returns the belongings and begins to understand why permission matters.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The child remains angry; the parent keeps the boundary without shouting or humiliation.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The child apologizes sincerely and offers to repair a damaged toy.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The apology is rushed and insincere; the parent explains that rebuilding trust takes action.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The parent learns that the child felt excluded and helps address that feeling without excusing the theft.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The child offers several excuses; the parent acknowledges their feelings but maintains the consequence.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The child helps sort and return shared toys before borrowing them again.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The child resents the consequence at first, and the parent patiently follows through.
